result.summary: The environment is a dense urban corridor with sidewalks but lacks basic crossing infrastructure like marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at a signalized intersection. The presence of old trolley tracks and construction activity introduces additional physical hazards for those navigating the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of painted crosswalks at a signalized intersection increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Exposed metal tracks in the roadway can cause trips for pedestrians or catch bicycle tires.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt near the tracks creates a tripping hazard.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks. The environment includes pedestrian signals and street lighting, though the road surface is worn and construction fencing on the corner creates a visual obstruction.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven road surface within the crosswalk area.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Opaque construction fencing on the corner blocks sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond the fencing.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked roadway surface to eliminate potential tripping hazards in the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection with mature street trees, wide sidewalks, and institutional land use. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and a marked crosswalk are present, the markings are faded and sightlines are partially obscured by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk, wide sidewalks, and a 'No Turn On Red' sign. While basic infrastructure is present, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded and dedicated pedestrian signals are not clearly visible.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Visible Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walk/don't-walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.
